nomen.name: Closest Points
nomen.info: Find the group of closest points within a search radius.

inputs.name: Point
inputs.info: Starting point for nearest point search.

inputs.name: Minimum Radius
inputs.info: Optional minimum radius. Points closer than this value will be omitted from the local group.

inputs.name: Maximum Radius
inputs.info: Optional maximum radius. Points further than this value will be omitted from the local group.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: All the points in the local group.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of points in the local group.

nomen.name: Decimate Points
nomen.info: Remove points from a cloud based on proximity.

inputs.name: Radius
inputs.info: Crater radius around each remaining point.

inputs.name: Bias
inputs.info: Picking bias. -1.0 = closest, 0.0 = random, +1.0 = furthest. (this parameter is currently ignored)

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Remaining points.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all remaining points.

nomen.name: Group By Chain
nomen.info: Cluster nearby points into groups by chaining each point to its close neighbours.

inputs.name: Distance
inputs.info: Maximum hop distance between points in the same group.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Points in each group, one branch per group.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of points in each group (relative to the input cloud), one branch per group.

nomen.name: Group By Density
nomen.info: Cluster densely-packed points into groups, leaving sparse outliers out as noise.

inputs.name: Distance
inputs.info: Neighbourhood radius used to count how many points sit close to each candidate.

inputs.name: Minimum Points
inputs.info: Minimum number of points (including the point itself) inside the neighbourhood radius for a point to anchor a group. Points with fewer neighbours are dropped as noise.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Points in each group, one branch per group.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of points in each group (relative to the input cloud), one branch per group.

outputs.name: Outliers Points
outputs.info: Points classified as noise — those without enough neighbours to anchor or join a group.

outputs.name: Outliers Indices
outputs.info: Indices of the noise points relative to the input cloud.

nomen.name: Group By Grid
nomen.info: Cluster points that fall into the same grid cell.

inputs.name: Cell Size
inputs.info: Side length of each grid cell. Points sharing a cell form a group.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Optional plane the grid is aligned to. When omitted, the best-fit plane through the points is used.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Points in each group, one branch per group.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of points in each group (relative to the input cloud), one branch per group.

nomen.name: Group By K Means
nomen.info: Partition points into a chosen number of clusters by grouping each point with its nearest cluster centre.

inputs.name: Seeds
inputs.info: Optional starting centroid positions. When provided, used in place of k-means++ initial picks. If fewer seeds than Count are supplied, the remaining slots are filled via k-means++; extra seeds beyond Count are ignored.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Points in each group, one branch per group.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of points in each group (relative to the input cloud), one branch per group.

outputs.name: Centroids
outputs.info: Final cluster centres — the mean position of each group's members.

nomen.name: Plane From Reflection
nomen.info: Create a mirror plane for an eye and a target location.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.info: Target point to be visible a the plane origin.

outputs.name: Plane
outputs.info: Mirror plane showing the target when looked at from the eye location.

outputs.info: Visual distance from eye to target as seen in the reflecting plane.

nomen.name: Plane From Axes
nomen.info: Create a plane out of an origin point and (X,Y) axis directions.

outputs.name: Plane
outputs.info: Plane with specified origin point and axis directions. Note that since the y-axis of a valid plane must be perpendicular to the x-axis, the plane y-axis may differ from the specified direction.

nomen.name: Plane From XZ
nomen.info: Create a plane out of an origin point and (X,Z) axis directions.

outputs.name: Plane
outputs.info: Plane with specified origin point and axis directions. Note that since the z-axis of a valid plane must be perpendicular to the x-axis, the plane z-axis may differ from the specified direction.

nomen.name: Plane From YZ

outputs.name: Plane
outputs.info: Plane with specified origin point and axis directions. Note that since the z-axis of a valid plane must be perpendicular to the y-axis, the plane z-axis may differ from the specified direction.
